thread:
maria: Quick design review — API Keys modal iteration. Posting screenshots: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234 (preview)
lee: Saw it. Main ask: simplify create flow. Current has 4 steps; can we collapse perms into inline suggestions?
ash: Agree. Also accessibility note: the 'Show secret' toggle should be an explicit button with aria-pressed rather than an unlabeled control. Suggest `aria-label="Show API secret"`.
jen: Copy nits: primary CTA 'Create key' is fine, but the confirmation banner currently says 'API key created' with no guidance to store the secret. Proposed copy: 'API key created — copy the secret now. It will not be shown again.'
maria: +1 on the copy. Also want an inline "Which permissions should I pick?" expansion that surfaces a compact role matrix (examples: "Read-only: embeddings, model-list" / "Service: generate, chat"). Keep it short.
lee: UX idea — when user selects 'Read-only' show a contextual advisory: "This key can only call embeddings and list models" with an inline :warning: and a link to docs.
ash: Rotation flow thought: after rotating, provide an optional quick-run button that executes a sample `curl` using the new key so customers can confirm behavior before retiring the old key. Could be a small 'Test new key' helper that pre-fills a snippet.
design-bot: Accessibility check: warning/banner contrast measured at 3.8:1 for current palette — below 4.5:1 for small text. Recommend adjusting banner background to #B66 or increasing text weight.
jen: Keyboard flow: when the modal opens focus should land on the key name input. After copying the secret, move focus to a live region/snackbar with `role="status"` and text 'Secret copied' so screenreaders announce it.
maria: Ops question — bulk revoke empty state currently shows a big CTA but no reason why keys are missing. Proposed empty-state copy: 'No API keys found — create a key or connect with OAuth. Learn about key scopes.' Keep link subtle.
lee: For mobile/responsive: on narrow widths hide the 'last used' column and collapse actions into a kebab menu to reduce clutter.
ash: Also consider a lightweight tooltip on hover for each permission with one-line examples to reduce cognitive load.
jen: One tiny nit: use sentence case for microcopy in the modal footers (e.g., 'Key expires in 90 days' -> 'Key expires in 90 days').
maria: I'll put all of this into the PR description for console and attach a11y notes. Tagging @lee to mock up the inline helper and @ash to add rotate acceptance criteria.
lee: I'll mock the compact role matrix + tooltip today and post updated frames.
ash: Will add aria props and update the sample `curl` snippet to copy-friendly format. :thumbsup:
jen: LGTM. follow-up: drop 'regenerate' label in favor of 'rotate' to match docs.
maria: Thanks everyone — syncing this into the feature branch and creating the follow-up tickets.
